speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I am here to evaluate your newborn. What specific symptoms or concerns prompted you to bring him in for this examination?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count
REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture
REQUEST TEST: Lumbar_Puncture

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the lack of prenatal care and immunizations, I need to rule out congenital infections. Does the newborn have any hepatosplenomegaly, rash, or microcephaly?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text: These findings are classic for congenital rubella syndrome, which aligns with the lack of prenatal care and immunization history. DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome
